reviews.heading: What customers say
weddings.title: Wedding and event flowers in Stockholm | Jomni Blommor
weddings.description: Bridal bouquet, flowers for the ceremony and the tables. Jomni Blommor on Södermalm plans the flowers around your day.
weddings.heading: Weddings and events
weddings.lead: Bridal bouquet, flowers for the ceremony and the tables at the party. We plan the flowers around your day, your colours and the venue.
weddings.alt: Sample image: bridal bouquet with roses, peonies and eucalyptus.
weddings.offer.heading: What we can do for you
weddings.o1.title: Bridal bouquet
weddings.o1.text: Tied by hand in the colours and flowers you love.
weddings.o2.title: Crowns and buttonholes
weddings.o2.text: Small details for the couple, bridesmaids, best men and family.
weddings.o3.title: Tables
weddings.o3.text: Flowers for long tables, round tables and the cake table.
weddings.o4.title: Ceremony and venue
weddings.o4.text: Arrangements for the altar, the entrance or the party venue.
weddings.s1: Get in touch with the date, the venue and roughly how many guests.
weddings.s2: We meet or talk about colours, style and budget.
weddings.s3: You get a proposal with a price to consider.
weddings.s4: We tie the flowers and have them ready for your day.
weddings.altTable: Sample image: a set dinner table with dahlias in a glass vase.
weddings.ctaText: Write a few lines about the date, the venue and what you dream of, and we will get back to you.
funerals.title: Funeral flowers in Stockholm | Jomni Blommor
funerals.description: Sympathy bouquets, wreaths and coffin sprays. Jomni Blommor on Södermalm helps you calmly and clearly.
funerals.heading: Funerals
funerals.lead: When someone has passed away, you want the flowers to be right. We help you calmly and clearly, from the first call until the flowers are in place.
funerals.alt: Sample image: white lilies in soft light.
funerals.offer.heading: Flowers for the funeral
funerals.o1.title: Sympathy bouquet
funerals.o1.text: A bouquet to place by the coffin or to give to the family.
funerals.o2.title: Wreath
funerals.o2.text: Round or heart-shaped, with a ribbon and a message if you like.
funerals.o3.title: Coffin spray
funerals.o3.text: An arrangement that lies on the coffin during the ceremony.
funerals.o4.title: Hand bouquet
funerals.o4.text: A simple bouquet to carry to the ceremony.
funerals.s1: Call or write to us. You do not need to know everything from the start.
funerals.s2: Tell us when and where the ceremony is, and if there are colours or flowers that meant something.
funerals.s3: We prepare the flowers and agree with you on pick-up or delivery.
funerals.ctaText: Write to us, and we will get back to you and go through it together.
business.title: Flowers for businesses and flower subscriptions | Jomni Blommor
business.description: Flower subscriptions for offices, receptions, restaurants and hotels, plus flowers for events and gifts. Jomni Blommor on Södermalm.
business.heading: Business and subscriptions
business.lead: Fresh flowers in the office, the reception or the restaurant, every week or when it suits you. And flowers for events and gifts.
business.alt: Sample image: a set dinner table with dahlias in a glass vase.
business.offer.heading: What we do for businesses
business.o1.title: Flower subscription
business.o1.text: New flowers every week, every other week or once a month.
business.o2.title: Reception and premises
business.o2.text: Arrangements that suit the room and are seen from the door.
business.o3.title: Events and client meetings
business.o3.text: Flowers for the conference, the dinner or the launch.
business.o4.title: Gifts
business.o4.text: Bouquets for clients and staff, with or without a card.
business.s1: Tell us about the premises and how often you want new flowers.
business.s2: We suggest size, style and rhythm, with a price.
business.s3: We bring fresh flowers on schedule.
business.ctaText: Tell us who you are, where you are and what you are looking for, and we will send a proposal.

shop.title: Shop: bouquets, roses and potted plants | Jomni Blommor, Södermalm
shop.description: Roses, bunches and potted plants from Jomni Blommor on Hornsgatan. Pick up in the shop, have them delivered via Wolt, or build your own bouquet.
shop.heading: Shop
shop.lead: Roses, bunches and potted plants from the shop on Hornsgatan. Pick up in the shop or have them delivered.
shop.pickup: Pick up at the shop, Hornsgatan 33A
shop.priceNote: Prices come from the shop’s menu on Wolt in November 2026 and may change.
shop.builder.heading: Build your own bouquet
shop.builder.text: Choose the occasion, size, colours and flowers you love, and we will tie it for you.
shop.deliveryText: Order via Wolt for delivery, or send a request and pick up in the shop.
builder.title: Build your bouquet | Jomni Blommor, Södermalm
builder.description: Choose the occasion, size, colours and flowers, and Jomni Blommor on Hornsgatan will tie your bouquet. Pick up in the shop or have it delivered.
builder.heading: Build your bouquet
builder.lead: Choose step by step. The picture shows roughly how the bouquet will look, and the florist ties it from your choices and what is lovely this season.
builder.previewNote: Sketch. The finished bouquet is tied by hand and will be unique.
builder.size.smallHint: A few stems, lovely on a small table.
builder.flowersHint: Pick several if you like. We use flowers that are lovely this season, so one may be swapped for something similar.
builder.cardHint: Optional. We add the text on a card.
builder.deliveryHint: We will get back to you about the price and time for delivery.
builder.doneTitle: Thank you, we have received your bouquet
